en.t: Kongo-in was known far and wide.

units.source_text: 这座名刹坐落在从安冈徒步约15分钟路程的山后。

en.t: This famous temple stood behind a mountain about fifteen minutes on foot from Yasuoka.

units.source_text: 那里有高丘亲王亲手种植的框树，

en.t: There was a kado tree said to have been planted by Prince Takaoka himself,

units.source_text: 还有据传是左甚五郎①建造的优雅的三重塔。

en.t: and also an elegant three-storied pagoda said to have been built by Hidari Jingoro①.

units.source_text: 夏天，我们总喜欢到后山的瀑布沐浴嬉耍。

en.t: In summer, we always liked going to the waterfall behind the mountain to bathe and play.
